versions.changelog:
- Added explicit required environment variable (ATTIO_API_KEY) under `credentials` in SKILL.md.
- Updated version to 1.0.1 in the metadata.
- No changes to core functionality; documentation improvements only.

Initial release with direct Attio CRM integration for OpenClaw.

- Full CRUD support for companies and people (create, read, update, delete).
- Add notes to any record directly.
- Execute real-time operations via direct Attio API key—no OAuth or proxy required.
- Supports command-line interface with flexible query, pagination, and record manipulation.
- Includes setup instructions and example commands.
